lot: 1.C (Phase 1, P0) — KDS adaptive polling fallback with version-gate and dedupe. Backend exposes a new sync endpoint; frontend introduces an adaptive poller that pauses when WebSocket is healthy, accelerates when degraded, and never overwrites fresher state.
finding_origin: F-03 (audit massif POS↔Kiosk↔KDS, sourced reports/audit/AUDIT_MASSIF_POS_KIOSK_KDS_SYNC_2026-04-23.md). NEW-02/NEW-04 from second-opinion GPT-5.4-pro reinforced: a static 30s polling fallback is too slow for kitchen rush AND can race with WS replays. We need adaptive cadence + version-gate + dedupe + backoff.

query_params.since: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC). Required. The client's last successful sync stamp. Server returns deltas after this moment.
query_params.branch_id: Optional integer. Admin (auth user branch_id=0) MAY override; for non-admin, server ALWAYS uses auth user branch_id (ignore query value). When branch_id resolved is 0 (admin global view), server returns all branches active orders.
query_params.include_deleted: Optional bool, default true. When true, also returns deleted_ids of orders that left the active window (status changed to DELIVERED/CANCELED/REJECTED OR soft-deleted) since `since`.

response_200_shape.server_now: ISO-8601 timestamp UTC — used by client as next 'since' value
response_200_shape.branch_id: int|null — the branch scope actually applied (echoed for sanity)
response_200_shape.version: int — monotonic counter from cache or db sequence; informational, NOT required for client correctness
response_200_shape.orders: array of objects — active orders that have been created OR updated since `since`. Each item MUST include: id (int), order_serial_no (string), status (int), updated_at (ISO-8601), version (int = max(updated_at_unix, status_changed_at_unix) — used by client version-gate). Plus the same shape as KDSOrderDetailsResource so the client can reuse its existing render code.
response_200_shape.deleted_ids: array of int — order ids that no longer belong to the active KDS window (left to DELIVERED/CANCELED/REJECTED OR soft-deleted) since `since`.

error_responses.403: Auth user lacks kitchen-display-system permission, or non-admin user passed cross-branch branch_id.
error_responses.503: Synthetic — used by frontend tests to validate backoff. Not produced by real backend code path.

endpoint_contract.performance_target: p99 < 250ms when called every 5s by a single branch with up to 50 active orders.
endpoint_contract.caching_strategy: Use Cache::remember("kds.sync.{branch_id}.{minute_bucket}", 5, fn() => …) to coalesce concurrent polls in the same minute. Cache key MUST include the resolved branch_id (multi-tenant key isolation).

kds_sync_service_php_contract.responsibility: Pure read-side query that returns active KDS orders updated since a given timestamp + the ids of orders that recently left the active window. NO write side-effects.
public_methods: sync(int $branchId, \DateTimeImmutable $since, bool $includeDeleted = true): array — returns ['server_now' => string, 'branch_id' => int|null, 'version' => int, 'orders' => array, 'deleted_ids' => array]
computeOrderVersion(\App\Models\Order $order): int — returns max(updated_at->getTimestamp(), status_changed_at->getTimestamp()) — single helper, called by sync() to enrich each order
implementation_notes: Use Order::with('orderItems') and the SAME active-window predicate as KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::list (status IN [ACCEPT, PREPARING, PREPARED] + today/advance window).

For deleted_ids: query Order::onlyTrashed()->where('deleted_at', '>=', $since)->where('branch_id', $branchId)->pluck('id') AND Order::where('updated_at', '>=', $since)->whereIn('status', [DELIVERED, CANCELED, REJECTED])->where('branch_id', $branchId)->pluck('id'). Merge + unique.
server_now = (new CarbonImmutable())->toIso8601String() — captured at the START of the request before reads to avoid time drift losses.
version = (int) (microtime(true) * 1000) — coarse monotonic; NOT used for correctness, only telemetry. Client correctness comes from per-order `version` field.

constructor_args.wsService: Reference to wsService (defaults to window._wsService if absent — gracefully degrades)
constructor_args.fetchFn: Optional fetch function override (for tests); defaults to window.fetch.bind(window)
constructor_args.now: Optional () => Date.now() override (for tests); defaults to Date.now

public_api.start(branchId): Begin the adaptive poll loop for the given branch. Idempotent — calling twice is a no-op until stop() is called.
public_api.stop(): Cancel any pending interval / timeout. Idempotent.
public_api.forceSync(): Trigger an immediate sync regardless of current cadence. Returns Promise resolving with the server payload. Useful for manual refresh button.
public_api.on(eventName, callback): Subscribe to events: 'sync', 'error', 'state_change', 'cadence_change'. Returns an unsubscribe fn.
public_api.get lastSyncAt(): Returns ISO-8601 string of last successful sync, or null.
public_api.get currentIntervalMs(): Returns number — currently active polling interval in ms (Infinity when paused).

cadence_rules_table.wsState_CONNECTED: intervalMs = Infinity (poll paused). One drift-check ping every 60s only.
cadence_rules_table.high_activity_override: If lastSync returned > 5 new orders in the last 60s window, AND wsState != CONNECTED → intervalMs = 3000 + jitter(0..1000)
cadence_rules_table.backoff_on_5xx: On HTTP 5xx response, double the current interval (cap 30000), enter STATE.BACKOFF. Reset to normal cadence on next 2xx response.
cadence_rules_table.abort_on_session_invalid: If wsState becomes SESSION_INVALID, log warning, keep polling at 10s — user must reload (banner already exists). Do NOT spam refresh-token endpoint.

kds_sync_service_js_contract.version_gate_logic: On each successful sync, for each order in payload.orders, ALWAYS emit 'sync' event but include a `versionGated:true` flag if existing client store has a higher or equal version for that id. KDS component renderer uses this flag to skip re-render. Implementation tip: maintain a Map<orderId, version> inside KdsSyncService.
kds_sync_service_js_contract.dedupe_logic: Map<orderId, lastSeenVersion> with FIFO eviction at 256 entries. If incoming version <= lastSeen, mark versionGated:true. Otherwise update map and emit fresh.

events_payload_shape.sync: { orders: [...], deleted_ids: [...], server_now: string, lastSyncAt: string, gatedIds: number[] /* ids that were rejected by version-gate */ }
events_payload_shape.error: { status: number|null, message: string, willRetryInMs: number }
events_payload_shape.cadence_change: { from: number, to: number, reason: string /* 'ws_connected'|'ws_degraded'|'ws_disconnected'|'high_activity'|'backoff_5xx'|'reset_after_200' */ }

kds_component_integration.lifecycle: In mounted(): import kdsSyncService, call kdsSyncService.start(this.$store.getters['auth/authBranchId']) AFTER subscribeEcho(). In beforeUnmount(): kdsSyncService.stop() and unsubscribe from its events.
kds_component_integration.merge_strategy: On 'sync' event: for each order NOT in gatedIds, the existing _debouncedRefresh() is sufficient (already idempotent at backend list level). Optimization not required — the refresh already filters and renders correctly. Goal of this lot is correctness, not micro-optimization.
kds_component_integration.ui_badge_lastSyncAt: Add a small footer-style div in the KDS template (above the closing of the main grid) that displays: {{ $t('label.kds_sync_stamp', { ago: humanizedAgo }) }}. humanizedAgo computed from kdsSyncService.lastSyncAt (e.g., '8s', '2m'). Color: gray when fresh, orange after 30s without sync.

non_negotiable_constraints: Backend: NEVER trust ?branch_id from client for non-admin users; always derive from auth()->user()->branch_id.
Backend: Cache key MUST include the resolved branch_id to prevent multi-tenant cache poisoning.
Backend: GET /api/admin/kds-order/sync MUST be idempotent (no DB writes, no event dispatch).
Frontend: KdsSyncService MUST NOT instantiate a second WebSocket — it is purely an HTTP poller.
Frontend: When wsService.state == 'CONNECTED', polling MUST be paused (intervalMs = Infinity). Verify via tests.
Frontend: Aborting a stale fetch when stop() is called — use AbortController; do not let stale responses fire 'sync' events after stop().
Frontend: Singleton enforcement — multiple .start() calls without .stop() in between MUST be no-op (do not stack timers).
All new files: include a header docblock referencing F-03, NEW-02, NEW-04 (cite plans/MEGA_PLAN_SYNC_HARDENING_v3_2026-04-23.md as authority).
i18n keys: add the 3 keys (kds_sync_stamp, kds_sync_never) in fr/en/ar JSON files; do NOT touch other keys.
Tests: NEVER use real timers in vitest specs — use vi.useFakeTimers + vi.advanceTimersByTime.
acceptance_criteria_measurable: GET /api/admin/kds-order/sync?since=<iso> returns 200 with the documented shape; 400 on missing since; 403 on cross-branch attempt by non-admin.
When wsService.state === 'CONNECTED', kdsSyncService.currentIntervalMs === Infinity (no polling network calls).
When wsService.state changes from CONNECTED → DISCONNECTED, kdsSyncService emits cadence_change AND schedules the next sync within 10–13 seconds.

Two consecutive polls returning the same order with version=N → second emit has versionGated:true for that id, the KDS component does NOT re-render that card (verified by spy on _debouncedRefresh in component spec — out of scope here, the unit-level guarantee is the gatedIds payload).
On HTTP 503 response, currentIntervalMs doubles, capped at 30000. On next 2xx, cadence resets to the WS-state-driven base.
All 7 backend tests + 7 frontend tests pass.
Existing KDS component subscribeEcho() flow is NOT broken (regression test: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent mounts without console errors).
